enemy_check.summary: PASS: Shore/Scout/Brute health, pursuit speed, warning radius/timing, damage, escape, interruption, hit feedback and single defeat

free_combat_check.summary: PASS: no target buttons, binding, marker or selection API; Tab leaves facing/camera alone; free movement, manual camera and sword damage remain functional

campaign_smoke.summary: PASS: camp, resume, healing, pause, rewards, upgrades, and save reload

chapter_route_check.summary: PASS: real shore/foothills/forest/ruins/grove round trip, Moonleaf return, 711 waypoints and unchanged-progress save/reopen

persistent_world_check.summary: PASS: persistent island, pickups, cleared demons, waystones, health/potions, death resume, lantern resume, continued exploration and one-time rewards

jump_check.summary: PASS: round nonoverlapping jump icon, keyboard/touch launch, start/air/landing motion, bounded height, moving jumps, no repeat/double jump, action guards and sea-wall collision at 15 FPS
